story: A one-way ride of 405 km, Doha to Doha - roughly 6 h 59 in the saddle. It goes by way of Al Zubarah Archaeological Site, Madinat Hamad 3 Burial Mound Field, Madinat Hamad 2 Burial Mound Field and back through Madinat Hamad 3 Burial Mound Field. It crosses from Qatar into Bahrain - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. A steady touring day rather than a sprint. Highlight: 2 ferry crossings (Dār Kulayb, about 24 km; Madīnat Ḩamad, about 24 km) - check timetables before you go.
